name: Claude in Xcode
desc: Claude coding agent running inside Apple's Xcode
desc_zh: 在 Apple Xcode 里运行的 Claude 编码智能体
solves: Apple developers had to leave Xcode to use Claude; the agent now edits and builds inside the IDE.
solves_zh: Apple 开发者过去得离开 Xcode 才能用 Claude，现在智能体可直接在 IDE 里改代码。
best_for: You are fixing a SwiftUI layout and want the agent's edit applied in Xcode immediately.
best_for_zh: 正在调 SwiftUI 布局，希望智能体的修改直接在 Xcode 里生效。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://www.anthropic.com/news/product and https://claude.com/resources/arti）。 Outside the window. Generally available on 2025-09-15 with Xcode 26, powered by Claude Sonnet 4 at launch. Homepage is the official docs page. Second source is not independent media. 首次公开日期来源：https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-in-xcode
